actions.idle: bouncing lightly on the balls of their feet in their fighting stance, shoulders rolling, fists up, breathing hard, ready to fight
actions.walk: walking forward with a strong, confident stride: the left foot steps forward, then the right, arms swinging opposite the legs, one full walk cycle
actions.crouch: holding a deep low crouch, bobbing slightly up and down, shifting their weight from foot to foot
actions.fall: falling through the air: arms out and waving for balance, legs pedalling, clothes and hair flapping upward
actions.shield: bracing hard behind their raised forearms, flinching and pushing forward against an impact
actions.ledge: hanging by both hands from an invisible bar above the head, swinging their legs back and forth, with nothing else in the picture
actions.dizzy: dazed and staggering on the spot: head lolling in circles, knees buckling, arms dangling, swaying side to side
actions.helpless: falling out of control: limbs flailing and loose, body slowly tumbling forward
actions.hurt: reeling from a big hit: head snapping back, body bending backward, arms and legs flung out and flailing
actions.jumpsquat: quickly bending both knees deep into a crouch, loading up to jump
actions.jump: springing up off both feet: knees straighten, arms swing up overhead, then the knees tuck up as they rise into the air
actions.land: landing hard from the air: feet hit the ground, knees bend deep to absorb it, then they rise back into their stance
actions.roll: diving forward into a fast forward roll along the ground: tucking into a ball, rolling over once, and springing back up to a crouch
actions.dodge: a quick dodge on the spot: twisting the body sideways and leaning far back out of the way, then snapping back
actions.airdodge: a quick dodge in midair: twisting the whole body into a sideways spin, arms tucked in
actions.climb: pulling themselves up from hanging by the hands, swinging a leg up and over an invisible edge, and rising to stand, with nothing else in the picture
actions.jab: throws a fast jab: snaps the lead fist straight forward until the arm is fully extended, then pulls it back to guard
actions.ftilt: throws a strong forward kick: lifts the front knee, snaps the leg straight out forward at hip height, then pulls it back
actions.utilt: throws a rising uppercut: dips the knees, then drives the fist straight up above the head, arm fully extended
actions.dtilt: a low sweeping kick from the crouch: sweeps the extended leg along the floor in front of them, then pulls it back
actions.fsmash: winds up a huge punch: pulls the fist far back and twists the body away, holds it, then lunges forward and swings a full-power haymaker
actions.usmash: crouches low, then explodes upward with a huge two-handed strike straight up over the head, leaving the ground slightly
actions.dsmash: drops low and spins a powerful sweeping kick in a full circle along the ground, hitting both in front and behind
actions.nair: in midair, spins the whole body in a fast circle with arms and legs stretched out
actions.fair: in midair, swings a big overhead strike forward and down in front of them
actions.bair: in midair, twists and lashes a powerful kick straight backward behind them
actions.uair: in midair, flips and swings a kick straight up above their head
actions.dair: in midair, stomps both feet straight down hard below them
actions.upb: leaps straight up with a powerful rising special move, spinning upward with an arm thrust overhead, then goes limp at the top
actions.nspecial: charges up their signature special move and lunges forward, unleashing it with a dramatic forward thrust

_poses: Poses are stills of each fighter, side view facing right (the Poses tab makes and picks them). Every clip starts on its "frames" start pose and, when it has one, ends on its end pose: loops start and end on the same pose, so they loop cleanly; moves return to their stance so they flow back into idle.

stand.label: Standing
stand.action: standing in their relaxed fighting stance, weight balanced on both feet, ready to move

stride.label: Striding
stride.action: mid-stride while walking forward: the front leg reaching forward with the heel down, the back leg pushing off, arms swinging opposite the legs

crouch.label: Crouching
crouch.action: crouching low on deeply bent knees, ready to spring, head still up and alert

air.label: Airborne
air.action: in midair with both feet off the ground, knees slightly tucked, arms out for balance

guard.label: Guarding
guard.action: braced to block: knees bent, forearms raised in front of the face and chest, chin tucked

hang.label: Hanging
hang.action: hanging by both hands from an invisible bar: arms stretched straight up overhead, hands closed around empty air just above the head, body dangling straight down below, legs loose, feet off the ground. There is nothing in their hands and nothing else in the picture: only the character on the plain background

hurt.label: Hurt
hurt.action: just hit hard and knocked back: body arched backward, head snapped back, arms and legs flung out

tumble.label: Helpless
tumble.action: exhausted and falling helplessly after a big move: limbs loose, body tilted, eyes half closed

dizzy.label: Dizzy
dizzy.action: dazed and unsteady on wobbly legs, slumped forward, head lolling, about to topple

_speed: Playback speed applied when a video becomes frames (1 = as generated, 2 = twice as fast). It matters for loops and for jump / jump start, which play at their own pace; moves and the other one-shots are stretched to their timing in the game, so for those it only changes how much of the motion fits in the frames (trim the wind-up instead). A fighter can override it per clip in the clip editor.
